clue: Elton John wrote the music for The Lion King's songs, and this lyricist wrote the words, winning an Oscar for Can You Feel the Love Tonight.

clue: In 1992, Beauty and the Beast became the first animated feature ever nominated for this Academy Award.
reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Best Picture! The Best Animated Feature category didn't even exist until 2001. Be our guest, champion!

clue: Frozen was loosely inspired by this Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale.
reveal: The correct answer is The Snow Queen! [chuckles] Disney tried to adapt it for decades before finally letting it go.

clue: This actor provides the clucks and squawks of Moana's dim-witted rooster, Heihei.
reveal: The correct answer is Alan Tudyk! [laughs] He's Disney's good-luck voice, from King Candy to the Duke of Weselton. Not bad for a chicken.

clue: Disney's Bambi is based on a 1923 novel by this Austrian author.
reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Felix Salten! His book was called Bambi, A Life in the Woods. [whispers] Much sadder than the movie, if you can believe it.

clue: Before the other elephants mock him as Dumbo, Mrs. Jumbo gives her baby this official name.
reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Jumbo Junior! The meanies renamed him Dumbo, and he turned it into a legend. Baby mine, don't you cry.

clue: In the 1967 film, Baloo the bear is voiced by this bandleader and comedian.
reveal: The correct answer is Phil Harris! [excited] Louis Prima was King Louie, Sebastian Cabot was Bagheera, and Sterling Holloway was Kaa. Ooby doo, nerd!

clue: In the 1961 film, dogs all over London pass along news of the stolen puppies using this nighttime barking network.
reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is the Twilight Bark! The original doggy group chat, and it worked faster than my Wi-Fi.
